Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez addresses education leadership and political events in Venezuela and Spain
On October 6, 2026, Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez posted about recognizing educational leadership locally while commenting on political developments involving Venezuela’s opposition movement and allegations against Spain’s prime minister.
Rep. Carlos A. Gimenez, a U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 28th district since 2021, posted a series of statements on October 6, 2026, addressing education and political developments in Venezuela and Spain.
In his first post at 13:24 UTC, Gimenez recognized the achievements of an educational leader: "Honored to recognize our dear friend Superintendent Dotres on his lifelong commitment to education & our community’s students. Lourdes and I wish him continued success in this next chapter! https://t.co/rO7DgrcIbR".
Later that day at 13:54 UTC, Gimenez commented on Venezuelan politics and the anticipated return of María Corina Machado: "#SOSVenezuela El regreso de @MariaCorinaYA a Venezuela es inevitable. María Corina ejemplifica la honradez, la decencia y la verdad. Su regreso al país fortalecerá el camino hacia la democracia y la libertad que todos queremos para el bravo pueblo venezolano.".
At 14:59 UTC, he criticized Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez for alleged corruption and international alliances: "Pedro Sánchez tendrá que enfrentar las consecuencias por su corrupción, por su complicidad con las dictaduras de #Cuba y #Venezuela, su financiación ilegal por los chavistas y los iraníes — y su respaldo a los terroristas anti-semitas. Es de la peor calaña y lo tenemos claro https://t.co/yObjEtuXfe".
Gimenez has represented Florida's 28th District in Congress since replacing Debbie Mucarsel-Powell in 2021 and previously served in both the Florida House of Representatives and the Miami-Dade County Commission from 2005 to 2011. Born in Havana, Cuba, in 1954 and now residing in Miami, Gimenez graduated from Barry University with a Bachelor of Public Administration degree in 1999.
